programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: WITH SCIENCE, WE LIVE
programme.desc: Humanity has learned from the past, transcended the present, and dreamed of the future."With Science, We Live"explores the frontiers of science alongside some of the world’s leading thinkers, offering insights into what lies ahead and uncovering new possibilities.In an era of rapid change, where are we headed?As we navigate between the vast universe and the smallness of human existence, we reconsider the direction we must take.Now, in this very moment, we imagine the future shaped by our choices—and move forward toward it.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: VIBE IN ACTION: K-INITIATIVE
programme.desc: The future has already begun. With AI now part of everyday life, technology is no longer a distant concept. Arirang TV’s [Vibe in Action] follows the key future industries driving Korea, capturing where innovation stands today—and where it’s headed. AI · Bio · Climate · Defense · Economy. Through these five keywords, <Vibe in Action> captures the “future moments” we’re living through right now.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: The AI industry has just had the fright of its life. After a shock US midterm election result handed Democrats control of both houses of Congress, the companies leading the AI revolution suddenly face an uncomfortable reality: investigations, subpoenas, public backlash and the prospect of sweeping new regulation. At the very centre of the storm is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, whose company sits at the heart of the global AI boom. Recent revelations surrounding Huang have triggered a crisis of confidence, wiped hundreds of billions from Nvidia's market value, and raised difficult questions about corporate governance, national security and the concentration of power inside the AI industry. Meanwhile, Elon Musk's political gamble appears to have backfired spectacularly. After pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into the midterms, Silicon Valley's most influential figures are now confronting a Congress that may be far less willing to give them the benefit of the doubt.

programme.title: Zpráva
programme.desc: Po 11. září začala CIA používat vůči lidem podezřelým z terorismu extrémně brutální vyšetřovací metody. Stačilo pouhé podezření. Vedlo to postupně k několika skandálům a také k vyšetřování programu na zadržování a vyslýchání. Hlavní hrdina amerického dramatu, senátor Daniel Jones (Adam Driver), je skutečnou postavou - snímek sleduje jeho pečlivou analýzu dostupných důkazů ''zdokonalených technik'', které se ukázaly být nemorální i neúčinné. Když se Jones rozhodne se senátním vyšetřovacím výborem zveřejnit výsledky svého vyšetřování, CIA a Bílý dům se tomu snaží zabránit.

programme.title: Tajemství rodiny Stokerů
programme.desc: Po smrti otce se k osmnáctileté Indii a její matce nastěhuje strýc, o kterém neměla tušení. India od začátku cítí, že tento záhadný člověk má postranní úmysly, brzy je jím ale úplně okouzlena. Po tragické smrti otce v den jejích osmnáctých narozenin se India Stoker seznamuje s Charliem, charismatickým strýcem, o jehož existenci až dosud neměla ponětí. Když se Charlie nastěhuje k Indii a její labilní matce, obě jsou okouzleny jeho šarmem a klidem. Brzy je ale jasné, že Charlieův příjezd nebyl náhodný, a že jeho šokující tajemství z minulosti mohou zásadně ovlivnit nebo dokonce úplně zničit Indiinu budoucnost.

programme.title: Dunkerk
programme.desc: Uznávaný filmař Christopher Nolan napsal, natočil a zprodukoval tento velkolepý válečný akční thriller. Snímek DUNKERK začíná v momentě, kdy jsou u severofrancouzského města Dunkerk německým vojskem obklíčeny stovky tisíc britských a spojeneckých vojáků. Uvěznění na pláži a s oceánem v zádech, spojenečtí vojáci čelí naprosto bezvýchodné situaci. A německá vojska jsou blíž a blíž. Příběh se odehrává na souši, na moři i ve vzduchu. Spitfiry Královského letectva se pouští do vzdušných soubojů nad kanálem La Manche ve snaze ochránit bezbranné muže pod svými křídly. Mezitím se narychlo sestavená britská záchranná flotila snaží zachránit přes 300 tisíc spojeneckých vojáků v operaci, kterou premiér Winston Churchill nazval "zázračným vysvobozením".

programme.title: Klub rváčů
programme.desc: Když nemůžete půl roku usnout, celý okolní svět vám začne připadat jako nekonečný sen. Všechno kolem vás je nedokonalou xeroxovou kopií sebe sama. Chodíte do práce, díváte se na televizi a jste vděčni za to, když občas ztratíte vědomí a nevíte o světě. Lidí s podobnými problémy moc není, ale mladý úspěšný úředník, který si říká Jack (Edward Norton), je jedním z nich. Má slušnou práci, vydělává slušné peníze, ale trpí nejtěžší formou nespavosti. Na služební cestě se Jack seznámí s Tylerem Durdenem (Brad Pitt), který mu nabídne příbytek pod podmínkou, že mu vrazí pořádnou ránu. Tato "výměna názorů" se oběma zalíbí a brzy vznikne první Klub rváčů. Místo, kde můžou mladí muži, znechucení světem, odložit své starosti a stát se na pár minut zvířaty.

programme.desc: V energickém akčním filmu se Rocky utkává se svým dosud nejsilnějším protivníkem - krutým svalovcem jménem Clubber Lang (Mr. T). V možná nejnapínavějším a nejpoutavějším dílu celé série jde Rocky od jednoho vítězství ke druhému, podepisuje lukrativní smlouvy a stává se slavným po celém světě. Když ale "italský hřebec" utrpí potupnou porážku od Clubbera Langa, zdá se, že pomalu ztrácí své výsadní postavení. S pomocí odvěkého rivala Apolla Creeda (Carl Weathers) se Rocky snaží znovu získat bojového ducha, aby se s Langem mohl utkat ve vyčerpávající odvetě o světového šampiona v těžké váze.

programme.title: The Wire - Špína Baltimoru
programme.desc: S02E03 Bunk s Freamonem pokračují ve vyšetřování nákladní lodi směřující do Filadelfie, nikdo z posádky však nerozumí anglicky. Poručík Cedrik Daniels, znechucený svým přeřazením do oddělení kontroly důkazů, se nechá slyšet, že dá výpověď. Na rozkaz Barksdala najde Bell způsob, jak se zbavit Tilghmana, který stále obtěžuje Wee-Beye. McNulty prověřuje Jane Doeovou, jejíž plovoucí tělo bylo nalezeno v přístavu. Dva z přístavních dělníků, syn Franka Sobotky Ziggy se synovcem Nickem, ukradnou náklad digitálních fotoaparátů, které prodají chlápkovi, co pracuje pro Řeky. D ́Angelo po nepříjemné návštěvě strýčka Avona Barksdala souhlasí, že ve vězení přestane s drogami. Konečně jedno moudré rozhodnutí.

programme.title: The Wire - Špína Baltimoru
programme.desc: S02E04 Sobotka se zlobí na synovce Nicka za ukradené fotoaparáty, chce, aby zastavil celý obchod, ale už je příliš pozdě. McNulty si sám sobě dal za úkol zjistit více o plovoucí mrtvole, ale jeho starý parťák Bunk ho upozorní, že mají na práci důležitější věci.

programme.title: Good bye, Lenin!
programme.desc: Říjen roku 1989 nebyl právě nejvhodnější čas pro upadnutí do kómatu, tedy aspoň pro občany Východního Německa. A přesně to se stalo Alexově matce, nadšené zastánkyni socialismu. Když se o osm měsíců později probudí, Alex stojí před velkým problémem. Její srdce je tak slabé, že by ji mohl zabít sebemenší šok. A co by Alexovu matku mohlo šokovat víc, než pád Berlínské zdi a konečné vítězství kapitalismu v jejím milovaném Východním Německu? Aby ji Alex zachránil, udělá z jejich společného bytu ostrůvek minulosti, jakési muzeum socialistické éry, kde si bude jeho matka připoutaná na lůžko užívat milosrdné nevědomosti a žít v přesvědčení, že se nic nezměnilo. Alexovi jeho plán nějakou dobu vychází, ovšem jen do té doby, než se matka začne cítit líp a odhodlá se znovu postavit na vlastní nohy.

programme.title: Vyměřený čas
programme.desc: V tomhle sexy, stylovém akčním thrilleru si zahrál Justin Timberlake a Amanda Seyfried. V budoucnosti, kde jsou doslova čas peníze a stárnutí se zastaví na hranici pětadvaceti let, je jediným způsobem, jak přežít, získat víc času - musíte ho však vydělat, ukrást anebo zdědit. Jenže když je chudý muž z nižší třídy (Timberlake) falešně obviněn z vraždy, spojí se s krásnou dědičkou (Seyfried) a snaží se vymyslet způsob, jak podkopat zkorumpovaný systém, dřív než jim odtikají poslední minuty jejich života!

programme.title: Gravitace
programme.desc: Oscaroví herci Sandra Bullocková a George Clooney se představí ve skvěle napsaném příběhu zasazeném do hlubokého vesmíru v režii Alfonsa Cuaróna (Potomci lidí). Ryan Stoneová je skvělá lékařka/inženýrka a právě zažívá svou první vesmírnou misi. Společnost jí mimo jiných dělá veterán Matt Kowalsky, který naopak svou kariéru astronauta právě končí. Během rutinní práce mimo základnu se však stane neštěstí, díky kterému se dvojice ocitne uprostřed vesmíru s omezenou dávkou kyslíku a s minimální nadějí na přežití. programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: V energickém akčním filmu se Rocky utkává se svým dosud nejsilnějším protivníkem - krutým svalovcem jménem Clubber Lang (Mr. T). V možná nejnapínavějším a nejpoutavějším dílu celé série jde Rocky od jednoho vítězství ke druhému, podepisuje lukrativní smlouvy a stává se slavným po celém světě. Když ale "italský hřebec" utrpí potupnou porážku od Clubbera Langa, zdá se, že pomalu ztrácí své výsadní postavení. S pomocí odvěkého rivala Apolla Creeda (Carl Weathers) se Rocky snaží znovu získat bojového ducha, aby se s Langem mohl utkat ve vyčerpávající odvetě o světového šampiona v těžké váze.

programme.title: Muži v černém 3
programme.desc: Agent Jay cestuje v čase zpět do roku 1969, kde se spojí s mladší verzí agenta Kaye a společně se pokusí zastavit ďábelského mimozemšťana dřív, než zničí budoucnost. S třetím dílem snímku Muži v černém se vrací také agent J (Will Smith) a K (Tommy Lee Jones). A vracejí se také v čase! J viděl za patnáct let v tajné službě spoustu nevysvětlitelných věcí, ale co mu vůbec nejde na rozum je jeho zdrženlivý partner. Ovšem když je život agenta K v ohrožení a s ním i osud celé planety, musí J podstoupit dobrodružnou cestu v čase a vše napravit. J zjišťuje, že existují tajemství vesmíru, o kterých mu K nikdy neřekl - tajemství, která vyplynou na povrch, když se J spojí s mladší verzí agenta K (Josh Brolin). Podaří se mu zachránit svého parťáka a osud lidstva?

Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un residente que hacía tiempo vivía en el pequeño pueblo de Lefroy, Tasmania, fue asesinado fuera de su hogar. El robo pareció ser el motivo, pero sin sospechosos, la investigación se detiene.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Encontrar al sospechoso
programme.desc: Los atentados con bombas son difíciles de resolver, porque el perpetrador no suele estar en la escena y la evidencia se esfuma.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando el número y volumen de manchas de sangre es mayor que la habitual en la escena del crimen, es el trabajo de los científicos forenses el determinar el por qué.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Se descubrió un esqueleto humano en las marismas de Carolina del Norte y, cuando los investigadores descubrieron que había estado muerta durante 18 meses, sabían que sería difícil descubrir quién era, y mucho más quién la mató.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1995, Denise O'Neill, una mesera de Palm Beach, es secuestrada y asesinada. Su vecino, Luis Caballero, levanta sospechas por su comportamiento extraño hacia los equipos de TV que cubren el crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1990, el cuerpo de Shirley Andronowich fue encontrado mutilado. Los testigos le dijeron a la policía que tuvo una pelea con su esposo la noche anterior, pero la evidencia forense demostró que él no tuvo nada que ver con su muerte.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Pedido fatal
programme.desc: Un hombre es encontrado muerto en su casa y su ex esposa tiene una coartada perfecta. Para determinar la hora de la muerte, los investigadores deben saber cuándo comió la víctima por última vez.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Se encontró a Janice Johnson muerta al pie de las escaleras del sótano. La policía de Nueva Escocia tuvo que desenredar las circunstancias que rodearon la muerte de Janice y responder a la pregunta: ¿Fue un accidente o un asesinato?

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1987, se descubrieron un cráneo humano y algunos huesos en un campamento de niños exploradores cerca de Farmington, Missouri. La reconstrucción facial ayuda a los investigadores en este caso.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1994, un cráneo humano recuperado de un estanque de Ohio revela un crimen espantoso. Las marcas en el cráneo indican que la víctima había sido apuñalada varias veces y que los dientes se le habían extraído con unos alicates de punta delgada.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La policía obtiene una pista sobre una pareja que desapareció en el fin de semana del Día de los Caídos durante un robo en marcha. La evidencia que se encuentra resuelve el brutal crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Impresiones fuertes
programme.desc: La esposa de un oficial de la Fuerza Aérea fue encontrada muerta en su cama con una bolsa plástica de lavandería cerca de su rostro.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery fue brutalmente asesinada en su negocio de Illinois. Los investigadores tuvieron que determinar si esto fue un robo que salió mal o un asesinato premeditado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En las zonas rurales de Canadá, el Dr. John Schneeberger es acusado de sedar y agredir sexualmente a una de sus pacientes y a su hijastra. Las pruebas de ADN demuestran que el doctor es inocente, pero la paciente insiste en que la sedó y violó.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1993, la joven madre Tammy Tatum fue encontrada agredida sexualmente y asesinada en su departamento de Longmont, Colorado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1969, la operadora telefónica de 25 años, Diane Maxwell, es violada y asesinada. Su hermano prometió que averiguaría quién fue el responsable y llevaría al asesino ante la justicia.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En el 2007, Brian y Beverly Mauck fueron encontrados muertos en su casa en Graham Washington. Usando una huella de la palma de una mano y de un zapato en la escena del crimen, los investigadores enfocan su atención en Daniel Tavares, quien había tatuado la espalda de Brian.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2003, el adolescente de St. Cloud, Jason MacLennan, regresó a su casa después de una noche con amigos y descubrió el cuerpo de su padre tirado en un charco de sangre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Pistas de Elefante
programme.desc: Los asesinatos de una pareja de ancianos dejan a la policía perpleja hasta que, dos años después, reciben un gran alivio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando encuentran muerta a la esposa de un dentista bien conocido, la policía se esfuerza por identificar a un sospechoso. Algunas fibras y un estudio de los patrones climáticos en la noche del asesinato abren el caso y revelan al asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una niña de doce años reclama que ha sido secuestrada y abusada sexualmente. Ella contó lo que había pasado con voz calma, sin alteraciones ni emociones, lo que hizo difícil que la policía le creyera.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1988, se descubrió el cuerpo de una mujer joven en un río de Ohio. La mayor parte de la evidencia había sido borrada, pero el hijo de 6 años de la víctima, sin saberlo, les dijo a los investigadores todo lo que necesitaban saber.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El sospechoso principal tenía un historial criminal y su licencia de conducir se encontró en la escena del crimen de un brutal homicidio doble.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En un tranquilo pueblo de Gran Bretaña, un granjero se encuentra con una apariencia escalofriante. Empalado en el poste de la cerca hay una cabeza de cordero cortada y una nota que dice: Usted es el próximo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Después de dispararle a sus víctimas en la cabeza, el asesino limpió la escena, colocó la evidencia incriminatoria en una bolsa de plástico y la arrojó al río.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Raspando la Superficie
programme.desc: Los científicos forenses trabajan con la única pista recuperada de un tiroteo con múltiples víctimas: una escopeta de calibre 12. Los científicos utilizan métodos únicos para extraer el número de serie del arma y rastrearlo hasta su propietario.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."

programme.title: Deadly Women: Greed
programme.desc: Known as “black widows,” these women kill their spouses, lovers and children for profit. Murder for them becomes a business. Their trade is murder. Their profit? Blood money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: We want to believe that all women would give their lives to protect their children. But there are horrifying cases when a mother will turn against her natural instinct and kill her own flesh and blood.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love to Death
programme.desc: Love and money are a beautiful marriage, for the lucky ones they create a life of happiness and ease. Unless the love is of money, the bride is a killer, and the groom their victim.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Behind their friendly smiles, deadly women hide histories of bloodshed and murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: In some cases, the transformation from everyday woman to brutal killer is activated by a man. A boyfriend or husband can become the focus of a deadly obsession.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?

programme.title: Deadly Women: Hearts of Stone
programme.desc: Deadly Women are not always the ones you expect. They are not the strangers lurking in the dark, they are a young mother, a supportive wife and a grandmother - all killers. Behind their loving masquerade lies a wake of family horror and pain.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Dog Is Smokin'
programme.desc: Dog is trying to cut down on smoking, but it's not easy with his high-stress job. Today, he must track down Walter, a fugitive who believes that the Canadian military has planted a chip in his tooth that allows him to communicate with his van.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: You Snooze, You Lose
programme.desc: Beth designs a luxurious new office for the team and shows it off to Dog, but the bounty hunter is more interested in starting his hunt for Federico, who's been revoked for missing court dates and generally running amuck.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Judgment Day
programme.desc: Dog goes on his a case, which involves Bobby, who's been on parole for three months pending sentencing on an assault charge. Bobby's girlfriend wants him back in jail, and Dog agrees that the Bobby needs to be behind bars.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Moms & Dads
programme.desc: Dog pursues two people whose lives have been ruined by drugs. First, he tracks Mae, who traded a good home and loving family for an ice pipe. The next case involves Jude. His addiction has caused his pregnant wife to fear for her safety.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Do Unto Others
programme.desc: Dog is a rough, tough bounty hunter, but he's a softie at heart, as the two cases in this episode show.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A Helping Hand
programme.desc: Dog answers two very different calls for help from women. In the first case, he helps Leland protect Maria, who's being threatened by her violent husband. Then Dog visit a young woman who's dying and has asked to see Dog as one of her final wishes.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
programme.sub-title: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
programme.desc: Baby Lyssa, who's just turned 18 and is studying to become a bondsman, gets to do some on-the-job training when she helps Dog hunt for Wayne, who's run out on a bond for second-degree assault.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: In Sickness and In Health
programme.desc: Dog is sick as a dog, but he still must lead the hunt for a fugitive named James. James' girlfriend tries to cover for him, but Dog surprises James in his bedroom and leads him away in cuffs.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: If the Shirt Fits...
programme.desc: Beth buys Dog a shirt with an embroidered chicken, but Dog explains he only wears shirts with pictures of either Jesus or a Harley-Davidson. When it's time to go to work, the team goes after Necia, a fugitive with felony charges pending.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Thief Who Stole Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas day, and Dog sets out to nab Raymond, who robs to support his ice habit, and give him a little Christmas gift - shiny new handcuffs.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rock-a-Bye Bounty
programme.desc: Dog and Beth must go after their former housekeeper, Lisa, who's jumped bond. They know this case will be tricky because Lisa knows everyone in the family. Luckily, Beth's nephew, Jason, is visiting and is quickly put to work as the bait.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Father-Hood
programme.desc: Before Tim heads out for a tough day of bounty hunting, he likes to get in a little quality time with his daughter, Summer Rain.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cops and Criminals
programme.desc: After giving a rousing speech to an audience of enthusiastic grade-schoolers, Dog catches up with an old friend, Sheriff Tommy Cayetano, to talk business. Dog's got a tough fugitive, named Mia, to catch and Tommy is happy to lend a hand.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cupid in Cuffs
programme.desc: It's the day before Valentine's Day and love is in the air at Da Kine Bail Bonds--but not for Tapi who has failed to appear in court on theft charges. Dog's plan is to have Leland knock on Tapi's door with a Valentine's gift to draw her out.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bonds of Love
programme.desc: Dog and Beth are finally getting married! They've been together for more than ten years but Dog is determined, as he puts it, to "marry his common law wife the Christian way."

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: To Love and to Cherish
programme.desc: Dog and Beth are off to the Big Island for their wedding. They hope to relax for a few days but it turns out Leland has a fugitive he needs to catch and despite the time limit, neither Dog nor Beth can resist the opportunity to catch a fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bustin' with Justin
programme.desc: Dog and the team must deal with misleading informants, belligerent boaters, and angry drunks when they go after Kimberly, a traffic offender with over 20 violations. And if that isn't enough, Dog has another problem - Duane Lee is sick.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Run Fugitive, Run
programme.desc: When the team hunts for Steven, a fugitive with a history of domestic abuse, they seek help from his girlfriend, who's been a victim of his abuse. Meanwhile, Beth trains for a 5K race to help raise awareness about domestic abuse.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Vegas or Bust
programme.desc: Dog is going to be the keynote speaker at the annual Profession Bail Agents convention in Las Vegas, but before he leaves he's got to clear two cases from his docket - Heidi and Stephanie.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Playing Possum
programme.desc: Tim's got a big problem. Owen has failed to appear in court. He's on bond for serious drug charges and now Tim could lose $30,000 if he doesn't catch Owen. With Dog's help he tries to track down the co-signer but they come up dry.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rainy Day Woman
programme.desc: It's been raining for days and the team is going a little stir crazy, but Dog has the cure; a good hunt. Maui has failed to appear on a drug charge and the team has just one lead. She was recently spotted during a bust at a local chop shop garage.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ticket to Ride
programme.desc: Dog decides it's time to outfit the Da Kine crew with new SUVs. After a quick visit to their local dealership, they go after Jasmine, a woman whose criminal record includes over 37 arrests for everything from drug promotion to assault.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mother Knows Best
programme.desc: Dog has two fugitives to catch, and he gets help from the unlikeliest sources - the fugitives' mothers. First, Ginger's mother wants to revoke her daughter's bond. Then, Brandon's mother decides to revoke his bond because Brandon has an ice habit.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Irons in the Fire
programme.desc: Dog is back hunting in the big city of Denver, but chasing fugitives on the mainland is more dangerous than ever. So Dog decides that the crew should get pepper-ball guns, which have much better range than pepper spray.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rocky Mountain Roundup
programme.desc: Dog decides to help two of his bondsmen buddies, Dave "Red" Widhelm and "Downtown" Bobby Brown. First up is Red, who has a client, named Alvin, whose bond is $20,000. Then the team goes after Craig, a client of Bobby's whose bond is almost $70,000.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: This One's For You
programme.desc: Dog leads the team on another adrenaline-filled chase in Denver. The fugitive, Robert, has a habit of address-hopping that makes him a difficult target, but Dog refuses to give up and finally tracks Robert down in his latest hideaway.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Baby Lyssa Steps Up
programme.desc: The team is still in Colorado, and today Dog starts his day by to giving his kids and crew a sample of their western heritage by taking them horseback riding. This hunt takes Dog back to his old stomping grounds in Denver.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Running on Empty
programme.desc: Dog's time is running out in Colorado. After a month of helping his bail bondsmen friends around Denver, he's got to get his family back home to Hawaii. But Dog wants one more capture before they leave.

programme.title: Josh Blue
programme.desc: Following his groundbreaking win on NBC's Last Comic Standing in 2006, Josh Blue has risen through the ranks to become a well-established headliner at venues throughout the world.

programme.title: Scotty K.: Not Country Music
programme.desc: Scotty K proves that he is a jack of all trades, or at least of two: the guitar and comedy. In this set, Scotty refers to everything from Rascal Flatts to Stretch Armstrong. If you miss the "good old days," this is sure to take you back!

programme.title: Steve Hofstetter: A Trip to Japan
programme.desc: Often called the "hardest working man in show-business", Steve Hofstetter covers everything from paper decapitations in plane crashes to seeing-eye children.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: If your type of comedian is someone who reminds us all how funny we all are, Chris Strait is for you! No funny topic is off-limits for this California native but he's just telling his story.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: As a mother of seven, Chelle T has seen it all, and shes not afraid to joke about it. Quippy and honest, Chelle T talks about how children are raised differently these days, menopause, being married for twenty-three years, and how desperate you sometimes become when youre a mom in this special.

programme.title: Mike Burton
programme.desc: Mike Burton delivers his comedy with high energy, great storytelling, and hilarious facial expressions. Mike started his stand-up comedy career in 1996 first performing in the local clubs in NYC, then gaining nationwide popularity. He has been on TV shows, independent feature films, and commercials for HP and Modells. Mike has also performed in daytime shows: Rachel Ray, The Chew, and ABC's The Revolution.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: Benny lives in Brooklyn where he fiddles around with old Land Rovers when he is supposed to be helping his wife run her natural skincare business. He has a dog named Grits and two cats who prefer that he not share their personal information in this bio.

programme.title: Tim Wilkins
programme.desc: Today that dream is more alive than ever as he is a 20-year veteran stand-up comedian, TV and radio personality, speaker and writer, who has performed on stages around the world. He has entertained millions in legendary venues ranging from Radio City Music Hall to chow halls in Afghanistan, to colleges, casinos and cruise ships.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: He simply reaches into a bottomless grab bag of jokes, so smooth and effortless that it would be easy to overlook just how much talent and skill is behind the process'"

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E07 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Hispania Rally 2020
programme.desc: Hispania Rally took place in Guadix - Granada in 2020. It achieved to host more than 180 participants from more than 26 countries. What the Hispania Rally strong as well as unique is the hard to drive, Gorafe desert. This extraordinary location has led the Hispania Rally to be recognized as the only European rally that takes place in the sandy and hot desert.

programme.title: XTERRA Adventures
programme.desc: S01E07 XTERRA is the world's premier off-road multisport event. An extreme competition, the XTERRA format combines swimming with mountain biking and trail running. It has been described as one part triathlon, one part mountain bike race, and one part "survival of the fittest". The typical distances are a 1.5k swim, 30k mountain bike, and 10k trail run.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.title: Aussie Racer
programme.desc: S01E05 Hosted by Australian motorsport legend Sandy Bowman. In 2013 Sandy Bowman and his navigator Daniel Hardman destroyed their off road race car in a massive crash. They have set out to build a new one, which is a huge undertaking, so to stay entertained Sandy and Daniel decided to compete in other forms of racing whilst the new car is being developed. Every episode Sandy and Daniel enter different events and wholeheartedly get into the spirit of that form of racing.

programme.title: Sports Adventure
programme.desc: S06E06 The Great Balloon Race. The world's oldest gas balloon race is not to be taken lightly. We follow the bold adventurers risking life and limb as they attempt to travel further than the rest. The race starts at the Wittringen Castle in Gladbeck, Germany, and follows a path that takes us above the clouds until it finishes in Greece.

programme.title: Sports Adventure
programme.desc: S06E07 The Desert Dash (Mountain Bike Racing). Namibia, the driest country in Sub-Saharan Africa and one of the least-densely populated in the world, hosts one of mountain biking's greatest challenges…"The Desert Dash"… 369 kilometers in just 24 hours, across the world's oldest desert; it's not one for the feint-hearted.

programme.title: Sports Adventure
programme.desc: S06E08 GS Trophy Mongolia (Off-Road Motorcycle Race). Teams from 21 nations tackle river crossings, deserts, rocky climbs and gruelling conditions as they tackle 2,200 kilometers through the lands of Genghis Khan - all ride exactly the same make and model of motorcycle, so in at least one respect, the playing field is level.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E07 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: iCarly: Ciao Carly – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly hat sich gerade damit abgefunden, dass sie nicht zum Ball gehen wird, als ihr Vater plötzlich auftaucht, um mit ihr hinzugehen. Carlys Abend nimmt eine weitere unerwartete Wendung, als ihr Vater ihr eine lebensverändernde Frage stellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Briggs sagt 'No!'
programme.desc: Mitgefangen, mitgehangen: Carly muss ausbaden, dass sich ihre beste Freundin und Banknachbarin Sam in der Schule mal wieder einen Streich erlaubt hat.

programme.title: iCarly: Eine leuchtende Idee
programme.desc: Carly hat die Idee, einen Wettstreit zu veranstalten und die Zuschauer online über den Sieger abstimmen zu lassen. Es geht darum, welches Team die beste Idee hat, wie man mehr Zuschauer für iCarly gewinnen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Schotte kommt selten allein
programme.desc: Carly und Co. fordern ihre treue Fangemeinde auf, ihre eigenen Tanz-Videoclips aufzunehmen und einzusenden. Die Reaktion ist überwältigend: In kürzester Zeit trudeln über 3.000 Videos ein – die natürlich alle gesichtet werden müssen.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein liebes Lied
programme.desc: Carly hat sich in einen Jungen aus der Schule verliebt. Weil sie ihn mag, lädt sie ihn dazu ein, in ihrer Webshow zu singen und Gitarre zu spielen. Leider merkt sie zu spät, welch ein schlechter Sänger Jake wirklich ist.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Großvaterdebakel
programme.desc: Carly und Spencer bekommen überraschend Besuch von ihrem Großvater. Er ist sehr besorgt darüber, dass Spencer nicht verantwortungsbewusst genug ist, um sich weiter um Carly zu kümmern. Carly und ihre Freunde versuchen das Gegenteil zu beweisen.

programme.title: iCarly: Nevel Supernerd
programme.desc: Carly und Co. bemühen sich darum, eine positive Kritik bei Nevelocity zu bekommen, einer Webseite, die über fünf Millionen Besucher pro Tag zu verzeichnet. Als sich Carly mit Nevel trifft, findet sie heraus, was für ein nerviger Junge er ist.

programme.title: iCarly: Absolut halloweenös!
programme.desc: Carly und Co. nehmen eine Show in einem alten Apartment auf, in dem es angeblich spukt. Als merkwürdige Dinge passieren, befürchten die Freunde, dass die Behauptungen über die Geisterwohnung wahr sein könnten.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Briggs privat
programme.desc: Carly & Co. betätigen sich als Spione: Sie wollen herausfinden, was ihre Lehrer so in ihrer Freizeit tun - und die nichts ahnenden Pädagogen werden dabei für die iCarly-Website gefilmt!

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Date für Freddie
programme.desc: Freddies neue Freundin Valerie stellt ihn vor eine schwierige Wahl: Sie will mit ihrer Internet-TV-Show am gleichen Tag auf Sendung gehen wie iCarly - und Freddie soll sie als Kameramann unterstützen.

programme.title: iCarly: Länger geht's nicht
programme.desc: Carly und Co. versuchen den Rekord im "Längsten Webcast der Welt" zu brechen. Dafür müssen die drei länger als 24 Stunden und acht Minuten auf Sendung bleiben.

programme.title: iCarly: Fühlst du die Reue?
programme.desc: Spencer rettet dem Sänger von The Plain White T's das Leben und bringt ihn dazu bei iCarly aufzutreten. Doch während der Show passieren merkwürdige Dinge.

programme.title: iCarly: Der Knöchelschwur
programme.desc: Carly bekommt eine Zwei Plus für eine Geschichtsarbeit, für die sie eine Eins verdient hätte. Sam nutzt die Möglichkeit während eines wöchentlichen Treffens mit Schulleiter Franklin und ändert Carlys Note am Computer in eine Eins.

programme.title: iCarly: Fan des Grauens
programme.desc: Das iCarly-Team kann sich über mangelnden Zuspruch wahrlich nicht beklagen - doch ein Fan stellt alle anderen in den Schatten: Mandy bombardiert Carly & Co. mit Zuneigungsbekundungen aller Art.

programme.title: iCarly: Kunst und Krise
programme.desc: Carly läd Spencers künstlerisches Vorbild Harry Joyner dazu ein, einen Blick auf Spencers Arbeiten zu werfen. Als Harry diese aber als amateurhaft einstuft, verliert Spencer seinen Sinn des Lebens.

programme.title: iCarly: Zieh die Hose bis zum Hals
programme.sub-title: Zieh die Hose bis zum Hals
programme.desc: Sam und ihr neuer Freund sind unzertrennlich. Aber als die Beziehung auch Einfluss auf iCarly nimmt, beschließen Carly und Freddie etwas dagegen zu tun.

programme.title: iCarly: Fang das Küken!
programme.desc: Für ein naturwissenschaftliches Schulprojekt wollen Carly und Sam einige Küken ausbrüten. Die Küken schlüpfen allerdings früher als erwartet und flüchten aus dem Brutkasten. Carly und Co. müssen die Küken überall suchen.

programme.title: iCarly: Geschenkt ist geschenkt
programme.desc: Carly schenkt ihrer Freundin Sam zum Jahrestag ihrer Freundschaft ein selbst bedrucktes T-Shirt. Umso entsetzter ist Carly, als Sam das Kleidungsstück wenig später gegen Konzertkarten eintauscht. Es kommt zu einem großen Streit.

programme.title: iCarly: Sponsorenglück
programme.desc: Carly und Co. werden in das Büro von "Daka" eingeladen. Ihnen wird eine Stange Geld dafür geboten, Werbung auf iCarly für "Daka's" neuen Schuh, den Tech-Foot, zu machen. Aber die neuen Schuhe stellen sich als schrecklich heraus.

programme.title: iCarly: Nachsitzen für alle!
programme.desc: Der 50. iCarly-Webcast steht bevor. Doch Sam wird kurz vor dem Ausstrahlungstermin zum Nachsitzen verdonnert. Die Strafstunden muss sie ausgerechnet zum Zeitpunkt der geplanten Sendung absitzen. Jetzt ist guter Rat teuer.

programme.title: iCarly: Räuber und Piraten
programme.desc: Zwei Cops haben sich bei Carly und Spencer eingenistet, denn sie haben den dringenden Verdacht, dass im Laden gegenüber Raubkopien von DVDs verkauft werden.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein schickes Angebot
programme.desc: Die Eliteschule Briarwood zieht in Erwägung, Carly ein Stipendium anzubieten. Carly ist sich nicht sicher, ob sie dieses Angebot annehmen soll. Doch Sam und Freddie wissen, sie müssen Carlys Meinung ändern.

programme.title: iCarly: Fechten wir's aus!
programme.desc: Freddie braucht eine Auszeit von den Mädchen. Daher ist er Spencer mehr als dankbar, als er ihn fragt, ob er mit zum Fechten kommen möchte. Allerdings wird es kompliziert, als Spencer ihn gegen den fiesen Doug Toder antreten lässt.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly TV
programme.desc: Der Programmchef eines großen Fernsehsenders ist auf der Suche nach einem neuen Hit und will iCarly zur TV Show machen. Aber Carly und Co. sind bald enttäuscht von den großen Veränderungen, die der Programmchef durchsetzen möchte.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Dreifach-Date
programme.desc: Als ihr Freund Gibby zu schüchtern ist, ein Mädchen, welches er toll findet, um eine Verabredung zu bitten, beschließen Carly und Co. eine Gewinnshow zu machen, bei der er ein Date gewinnen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly wird von den iWeb Awards auserwählt, in Japan für den Preis der Besten Comedy anzutreten. Carly, Sam und Freddie proben für den Auftritt einen Extra-Sketch ein und reisen zusammen mit Spencer und Mrs. Benson nach Japan.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 2
programme.desc: Da der Flieger nicht in Japan landet, müssen Carly und Co. mit dem Fallschirm abspringen, um zu den iWeb Awards zu kommen. Alles scheint gut zu gehen, bis sie auf Kyoko und Yuki treffen, die eine gemeinen Plan verfolgen.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 3
programme.desc: Nachdem Kyoko und Yuki Carly und Co. im Nirgendwo ausgesetzt haben, laufen die Drei völlig verzweifelt durch die Gegend. Spencer und Mrs. Benson, die sich befreit haben, versuchen, die Kids zu finden. Schaffen sie es rechtzeitig, Carly zu finden?

programme.title: iCarly: Alle lieben Shane
programme.desc: Als sich Carly und Sam für den gleichen Jungen interessieren, schwören sie sich, ihn nicht zwischen sie kommen zu lassen. Als sich jedoch beide um seine Aufmerksamkeit bemühen, wird ihre Freundschaft auf eine harte Probe gestellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack Rat
programme.desc: Carly muss eingreifen, als sie bemerkt, dass Spencer eine Videospielsucht entwickelt. Währenddessen versucht Sam Freddie davon zu überzeugen, dass er vom Pech verfolgt sein wird, wenn er eine Ketten-Email nicht weiterleitet.

Liesel finds the resurgence of Basque cuisine in Northern Nevada, and learns that Reno can do fine dining as well! A trip to Virginia city also reveals that the Silver State has some haunted bars where patrons from the 1800s are rumored to be still imbibing and spooking locals! programme.title: Sneaky Links
programme.desc: Tammy, a popular social media influencer, has a high libido, and loves a variety of men. When Tammy’s frenemy, Megan, gets wind of Tammy’s slutty ways, her engagement to Jewelz, a high profile professional athlete, is at stake.

programme.title: Street Dreams: Los Angeles
programme.desc: After a traumatic event that takes the life of a young Elijah Wilkins' childhood friend, Elijah meets an FBI agent that sets him on the right path. He vows to indirectly avenge his friend's death by becoming an undercover cop for the LAPD with hopes of working his way into the counterintelligence division of the FBI. When he stumbles upon a case involving domestic terrorism, Elijah sees this case as the perfect opportunity that could possibly usher him in the FBI, but not without risking it all.

programme.title: Suffocated: Room to Breathe
programme.desc: Lexxy wants it all: money, love, kids, a home. She has got the drive, now all she needs is the path. After a stint as a party promoter and criminal, she turns to the music business. Lexxy forms a female hip hop group, with dreams of breaking into the industry. Things look promising until lies and betrayal break up the group, and dissolve all friendships.

programme.title: Reality TV Murders
programme.desc: In the world of reality TV, Chasity Safire is a household name and has been the star of the hugely popular reality TV show “Diva’s Doing it” for the past 5 years. When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of the women would literally kill to be famous.

programme.title: Tethered Hearts
programme.desc: Token is a charismatic club owner who’s inherited his father’s iconic jazz club, and uses it at a sanctuary for the broken and struggling artists. When a shady music executive starts to recruit his talent, he fights to keep his club afloat.

programme.title: The Laundry Room Stalker
programme.desc: A string of murders on local neighborhood sex workers have been occurring around one specific apartment building’s laundry room. But all suspicion points to the newly hired attendant, Calvin who was just released from prison for 12 years.

programme.title: Trouble
programme.desc: As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Ceceilius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam’s jealousy spirals into a dangerous obsession, fueled by terrifying dreams and a mysterious woman, Robin. With a wedding on the horizon and secrets unraveling, love and betrayal collide, leading to a shocking conclusion where nothing is as it seems.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Mistress for Hire
programme.desc: Skylar works as a professional mistress hired by women for divorce leverage. When she finds herself falling for her target, Eric, she questions her career and her motives. But when Eric’s wife, Octavia, won’t allow Skylar to destroy her plans, and a dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with love and survival on the line.

programme.title: Heart of a Woman
programme.desc: Alisha, a rising model with a bright future, chose to put her career on hold to stand by her football star husband Jax. When an opportunity arises for her to return to the runway, their marriage is put to the test, and whether love or career holds the most weight in their relationship.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The inhabitants of Midsomer Magna are in the spotlight, quite literally when a production crew descend on the village and imposing Manor House. To film a version of The Scarlet Pimpernel. Not only the film crew arrive, but a notorious criminal as well, George Ince, lurking around the Manor. When Nick Cheney, the film's director is found dead, by the use of the prop guillotine. The detectives need to sift through many motives which lead to the complexity.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Holm, a rehabilitation scheme for reformed criminals continues. When Ronnie Tyler departs, he gets a good send off from everyone, including DCI Barnaby. Another attendee is Jack Colby, a disgraced ex-policeman and former colleague of Barnaby. Jack is decidedly frosty towards his once-former friend and refuses to chat. When Jack is later murdered, Barnaby must search for answers in Jack's past for motives.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The death of an ancient estate's patriarch leads to rivalry and murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The author of a book that sparked a nationwide treasure hunt is found dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Frank Bailey is a pet detective who is found dead in the kennel of a dog he was looking for.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Sleepy Goodman's Land is bought by a Texas oilman; following the sale, a string of grisly murders ensues.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young man is found murdered during its grand reopening, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter must unravel a sinister web of lies from both past and present in order to catch the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Bleakridge Watch patrols the streets of their remote village, exposing anyone who steps outside the law.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a star cricketer dies during a tournament, DCI Barnaby and DS Winters investigation draws them into a dangerous game with a surprise visitor from Barnabys past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby and DS Winter discover a dead body covered in live rabbits, it reveals a sinister side to the local pet show. Is this a rivalry taken too far or is the killer driven by something darker?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young girl slips away from a Jane Austen weekend dressed in period attire, and is found stabbed in the woods, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter need to look back in time to find the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter's investigations lead them deep into a world haunted by a potentially deadly curse.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Undertaker Patrick Pennyman is found dead in the village of Fletcher's Cross, in his own chapel of rest, by his wife. Barnaby and Scott start looking into a spiritualist church in the village that had been heavily controversial. Elizabeth, a friend of Joyce, who had attended their meetings, tells her that she was suspicious of both the spiritualist church and the undertaker and believed they were acquiring information and stealing from the dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Down at the Midsomer Regatta, the day is interrupted by the body of Guy Sweetman, Chairman of the local rowing club, resurfacing midway through a race. Barnaby and Scott learn that Guy was a ladies' man with many past conquests. He had been in secret meetings with a few other members. The two detectives uncover lies, blackmail, jealousy and a planned robbery, before the latest woman Guy was planning to marry is attacked and almost killed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a local handyman finds a female classics teacher and a member of a group of orchid enthusiasts poisoned in her own home, DCI Barnaby finds himself heading back to Midsomer Malham, the day after he and Joyce had helped out during the village's annual garden show. It is discovered that the victim had a secret lover and had helped to smuggle a rare one-of-a-kind orchid, the Yellow Roth, out of Borneo.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A successful day at the races for the racehorse, Bantling Boy, the previous day, it is not long before one of the horses' owners is found murdered in the horses' stables. The victim, Bruce Hartley, had been in dispute with the other owners of Bantling Boy, the night before his murder had had a rather heated argument with them and had refused to let them acceptance of an offer to buy the horse. It seems to make things a whole lot worse of the others in the syndicate.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: John Ransom gets thrown out of the village pub in Midsomer Mere, for fighting with his brother-in-law, and a short while later he is found dead on the green. It is discovered that John had been used as a guinea pig for scientific experiments by his brother Max, who suspected he had the ability of 'Second Sight'. Barnaby and Scott soon discover that another family possesses the same talent. They have to delve deeper to unravel many secrets within the village to find the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When solicitor Nick Turner apparently commits suicide by walking off the roof of his home in Midsomer Magna, then Nick's neighbour Jack Wilmot mysteriously disappears that same day, it starts a series of unexplained events. Barnaby and Scott soon discover that a large amount of money has gone missing from the account of one of Nick's clients. Shortly afterwards, Nick's rival gets murdered in an elaborate ritual, by his own model of a medieval catapult, while his wife is forced to watch.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The body of a visitor is found on-site at the famous relish factory of Plummer & Son in the village of Little Upton. When the detectives begin investigating the Plummer family and its staff, it turns out that the victim, Dexter Lockwood, was known to the family and had been on a guided tour of the factory the day before his body was found. It is not long before legal documents, family resentments and mysterious sightings add to the complexity of the case.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Retired music teacher Arthur Leggott is murdered after disturbing an intruder at his home in Badger's Drift. It is discovered that a musical manuscript by the late composer Joan Alder has since gone missing before being sent to auction. When the manuscript shows signs that it has been written by another hand, a handwritten letter by Joan Alder turns up indicating the manuscript is a forgery. Where the manuscript goes more murders follow.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Its Christmas and new detective Charlie Nelson moves into Midsomer. Hes thrown straight into an intriguing mystery in the village of Morton Shallows. A man is fatally stabbed with an antique sword.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A series of murders in Midsomer St Claire seem to be inspired by macabre images on a medieval fresco.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When wealthy farmer Martin Strickland is covered in truffle oil and mauled to death by a wild boar, the investigation leads to restaurant Wyvern House and its tyrannical celebrity chef Ruth Cameron.

programme.title: Barbie - magický delfín
programme.desc: V tomto zábavnom podmorskom dobrodružstve Barbie a jej sestry navštívia Kena na jeho letnej stáži, kde na korálovom útese skúma delfíny. Pri potápaní a objavovaní útesu sestry objavia vzácne, dúhovo sfarbené delfíny, ktorí priplávajú len raz za rok. Tento úžasný nález ich povzbudí k pátraniu, ako ochrániť koralový útes a všetok jeho morský život. Vtedy stretnú Islu, tajomnú novú kamarátku, ktorá je tiež na výprave za záchranou koralu. To, čo sa zdá byť ľahká úloha, sa zvráti v dobrodružstvo, keď vyjde najavo, že Isla je vlastne morská panna. Ale nie je čas sa radovať, že majú za kamarátku morskú pannu, pretože Isla potrebuje pomoc Barbie a jej sestier i vzácnych delfínov, aby zachránila situáciu.

programme.desc: Po nepríjemnom stretnutí so staromódnou kráľovskou rodinou si George nechcene vymení miesto s namysleným kráľovým opičiakom Phillippe. Phillippe prekvapuje Teda svojím dokonalým správaním a George cestuje do hradu, kde jeho zábavkami spôsobí pohoršenie a prinútia hanblivú princeznú Isabel vyliezť z ulity.

programme.title: Barbie Thumbelina
programme.desc: Barbie predstavuje príbeh Malenky v moderne prerozprávanej klasickej rozprávke. Zoznámte sa s drobným dievčatkom menom Malenka, ktorá žije v harmónii s prírodou v magickom svete. Z rozmaru rozmaznaného dievčaťa menom Makena prídu Malenka a jej dve kamarátky o svoj záhon divokých kvetín a skončia v luxusnom apartmáne v meste. Tam sa dozvedajú o stavebnom plánu, ktorý hrozí zničeniu krajiny. Malenka osedlá prírodnú mágiu a dokáže, že aj ten najmenší človek môže niečo veľké zmeniť.

Z rozmaru rozmaznaného dievčaťa menom Makena prídu Malenka a jej dve kamarátky o svoj záhon divokých kvetín a skončia v luxusnom apartmáne v meste. programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Folge 68 - 5. Staffel, Folge 68: 1980 startete der Audi Quattro, der Allradantrieb vom Wehrdienst leistenden VW Iltis, gepaart mit einem 200 PS starken Fünfzylinder-Turbomotor. programme.title: Evening Prime
इवनिंग प्राइम
ஈவினிங் ப்ரைம்
ఈవెనింగ్ ప్రైమ్
इव्हनिंग प्राईम
programme.desc: The host presents prime news stories, updates and developments on current affairs and socio-political issues in the region.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता क्षेत्र में प्रमुख समाचार, वर्तमान घटनाक्रम और सामाजिक-राजनीतिक मुद्दों पर जानकारी और घटनाक्रम प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் மற்றும் சமூக-அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் குறித்த முக்கிய செய்திகள், புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రాంతంలోని ప్రస్తుత వ్యవహారాలు, సామాజిక-రాజకీయ సమస్యలపై ప్రధాన వార్తా కథనాలు,విశేషాలు, పరిణామాలను అందిస్తారు.

इव्हनिंग प्राईम
programme.desc: The host presents prime news stories, updates and developments on current affairs and socio-political issues in the region.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता क्षेत्र में प्रमुख समाचार, वर्तमान घटनाक्रम और सामाजिक-राजनीतिक मुद्दों पर जानकारी और घटनाक्रम प्रस्तुत करते हैं।

వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రాంతంలోని ప్రస్తుత వ్యవహారాలు, సామాజిక-రాజకీయ సమస్యలపై ప్రధాన వార్తా కథనాలు,విశేషాలు, పరిణామాలను అందిస్తారు.

programme.desc: The host presents prime news stories, updates and developments on current affairs and socio-political issues in the region.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता क्षेत्र में प्रमुख समाचार, वर्तमान घटनाक्रम और सामाजिक-राजनीतिक मुद्दों पर जानकारी और घटनाक्रम प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் மற்றும் சமூக-அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் குறித்த முக்கிய செய்திகள், புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రాంతంలోని ప్రస్తుత వ్యవహారాలు, సామాజిక-రాజకీయ సమస్యలపై ప్రధాన వార్తా కథనాలు,విశేషాలు, పరిణామాలను అందిస్తారు.

programme.desc: In the year of 1762 when King Yeong Jo of the Joseon dynasty's been ruling for 35 years already Crown prince Sa Do is accused of plotting treason by his biological mother lady Yi. King Yeong Jo falls into a dilemma since he could not penalize his own son as a traitor as it would mean that he would become the father of a traitor threatening his throne and ends up ordering Sa Do to take his own life. As Sa Do’s lieges oppose King Yeong Jo’s decision by putting their own lives at risk King Yeong Jo locks Sa Do in a wooden rice chest to kill him.

programme.desc: Inspired by the life of renowned novelist Uno Chiyo, who pursued freedom throughout the Meiji, Taisho, and Showa eras, this drama tells the story of Hano Tama (Ishibashi Shizuka). Through disasters, war, turbulent relationships, and financial struggles, she remains true to herself and forges her own path, eventually becoming a celebrated novelist whose life and work inspire generations.

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente
programme.desc: In der Wüste - Im Mittelpunkt von "Avatar - Der Herr der Elemente" steht der zwölfjährige Aang, der in einer von den Herren des Feuers beherrschten asiatischen Fantasy-Welt lebt. Aang ist nicht nur der letzte Herrscher über die Luft, sondern auch der Avatar, der Herr über alle Elemente. Er ist derjenige, der über die Form von Wasser, Erde, Luft und Feuer bestimmt. Doch der Avatar war 100 Jahre lang in einem Gletscher am Südpol eingefroren, und während dieser Zeit sind die Herrscher des Feuers ihrem Ziel der totalen Weltherrschaft immer näher gekommen. Erst als Aang von Katara, der letzten Gebieterin des Wassers, und deren Bruder Sokka aus dem ewigen Eis befreit wird, hat er eine Chance, seine Mission ...

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
programme.desc: Pfannenwender des Himmels / Garys Spielehaus - SpongeBob Schwammkopf wohnt mit seiner Schnecke Gary in der Unterwasserstadt Bikini Bottom in einer Zwei-Zimmer-Ananas und arbeitet als Krabbenburgerbrater im Fastfood-Restaurant 'Krosse Krabbe', wo Mr. Krabs sein Chef ist. Neben dem Schwammkopf ist SpongeBobs Markenzeichen die eckige Quadrathose. Seine Freunde sind Tintenfisch Thaddäus, Eichhorn Sandy und Seestern Patrick. Sein Feind ist der fiese Plankton, der an das Geheimrezept der Krabbenburger und die Weltherrschaft gelangen will. Die Serie basiert auf wahren Begebenheiten. Nun, zumindest ist ihr Erfinder Stephen Hillenburg ausgebildeter Meeresbiologe, er müsste also wissen, wie es da unten zugeht.

programme.title: Willkommen bei den Louds
programme.desc: Das große Vorbild / Serien-Fieber - Der elf Jahre alte Lincoln Loud lebt zusammen mit seinen zehn Schwestern, fünf älteren und fünf jüngeren, in einem Haus. programme.title: NCIS

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs and the team rush to a scene where a high-level intelligence officer was murdered, only to discover that the crime took place three days earlier and was "investigated" by the local authorities.

programme.title: NCIS

programme.title: Paranormal State: Southern Discomfort At Sweetwater Mansion
programme.desc: PRS heads to the Deep South to investigate a haunted Antebellum Mansion in disrepair. The caretaker and volunteers at the property have many a tale to tell of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Night Terrors
programme.desc: Ryan leads his team to one of the most haunted places in the US to confront their fears and solve a paranormal mystery. Aside from the alleged spirits of dead prisoners, something even darker may be lurking inside West Virginia State Penitentiary.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Devil's Hostage
programme.desc: When a woman has long scratch marks mysteriously appear on her back, PRS is called in to see if they are truly facing the devil. But her credibility is called into question, a struggle of another kind emerges for Ryan and the rest of the team.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Return of the Dead: Glove II
programme.sub-title: Return of the Dead: Glove II
programme.desc: PRS returns to the site of one of their most famous cases, Daisytown, PA, where they had discovered a glove print of an old miner that they determined was the spirit of a Great-Grandfather.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Ladder
programme.desc: A large family in Shrewsbury, MA, has been living with a spirit for the last 40 years. To most of the siblings, the entity is menacing and evil, but Sandy seems to have a different connection.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Pet Cemetery
programme.desc: Ryan and his team investigate the bizarre haunting of a woman and her dog in Waterboro, Maine. The Labrador was chewing at her own fur and standing on guard on the bed, growling at unseen figures.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Bedroom Eyes
programme.desc: PRS travels to rural Pennsylvania to investigate a haunting that began after a new couple moved into an old family farm.?Over the next three days, hidden tragedies are uncovered and latent psychic abilities are revealed.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Family Ties
programme.desc: Jimmie is haunted by the apparition of a mysterious old woman who peers at him in the bathroom of his family's Petersburg, VA home.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Vegas
programme.desc: The PRS travels to Sin City to investigate a 14-year old medium who claims to speak to a dead girl.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Messenger
programme.desc: Kelli and her husband Riley are frightened in their coastal Oregon home. They are plagued by a headless apparition and often hear mysterious noises that resemble cries for help from the dark corners of their house.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Suicide Possession
programme.desc: Joan and her boyfriend Tony are seeing apparitions in their New Jersey home. Both are concerned that the spirits are influencing their behavior: a non-drinker, Tony has turned to the bottle while Joan has thoughts of harming herself.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Anniversary
programme.desc: Ever since a close-knit Kentucky family moved into their new home, they've been visited by the spirit of a young girl.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Hell's Gate
programme.desc: Ever since Wes and his family moved into their new home in York, PA they've been struggling with a dark force that's made everyday a living hell. Wes feels his mental and physical health is in jeopardy.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Glove
programme.desc: When a terrifying haunting threatens to break a Daisytown, PA couple apart, PRS is their last resort. As the investigation deepens, PRS and the family learn that it's just the tip of iceberg, turns out this haunting might be all in the family.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Darkness Falls

programme.title: Paranormal State: School House Haunting
programme.desc: PRS travels to Massachusetts to investigate an old schoolhouse where children's voices disturb a couple who've made it their home.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Hostage to Fear
programme.desc: P.R.S. is summoned to help a family who has been haunted for years by spirits lurking in the house. Upon arrival the team finds a family that has become prisoners in their own home.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Ghost On the Tracks
programme.desc: PRS is called to a New Jersey beauty salon, but they soon learn that the building's proximity to deadly train tracks might be the true cause of spirit activity.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Freshmen Fear
programme.desc: A young female student claims to have seen a ghost in her dorm room.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Paranormal Intervention
programme.desc: Carol Ann stays awake every night taping the voices of the dead. PRS cuts their winter break short to help her curtail her obsession and close this doorway to the dead--for good.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Beer, Wine and Spirits
programme.desc: Brian's bar has a cranky customer who's got a bad habit of breaking wine glasses. Charlie has been dead since prohibition.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Lady Vampire
programme.desc: PRS investigates a case involving single mom, Dawn, and her 5-year-old daughter, both of whom are tormented by the appearance of a hag they call "lady vampire."

programme.title: Paranormal State: Shape Shifter
programme.desc: PRS travels to Shapleigh, Maine where a woman and her daughter are reporting attacks from a winged creature with sharp teeth. Psychic Chip Coffey arrives and senses a half-human, half animal presence.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Boy Pushed Me

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Fury
programme.desc: Kathy, her two daughters and her new husband, "Farmer" thought they had the perfect, quiet life deep in the mountains of West Virginia.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Basement
programme.desc: A history of violence may connect the spiritual activity in Heidi's Ohio home to a long run of misery and cruelty.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Supernatural Seduction
programme.desc: PRS investigates the Campbell House, where the Innkeeper and guests claim to have sexual encounters with a spirit who has deep ties to a family tragedy.

programme.title: Paranormal State: I Am Six
