programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Saas Bahu Special
सास बहु स्पेशल
சாஸ் பஹு ஸ்பெஷல்
సాస్ బహు స్పెషల్
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.
टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்

programme.title: Rishto Ki Dor
रिश्तो की डोर
ரிஷ்தோ கி தோர்
రిష్తో కి డోర్
programme.desc: A collection of stories from people's daily lives, which teaches valuable lessons about being a good human being, is presented.
लोगों के दैनिक जीवन की कहानियों का संग्रह प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो एक अच्छे इंसान बनने के लिए अच्छे सबक सिखाता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க பாடங்களைக் கற்பிக்கும், மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையிலிருந்து வரும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
తల్లిదండ్రుల మరణం తరువాత తన ముగ్గురు చెల్లెళ్లను చూసుకోవడానికి చాలా కష్టపడుతున్న సుహాస్ చాలా సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya

தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

டெலிஷாப்பிங்

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

மஸ்கரி

தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.

మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

ரிஷ்தோ கி தோர்

తల్లిదండ్రుల మరణం తరువాత తన ముగ్గురు చెల్లెళ్లను చూసుకోవడానికి చాలా కష్టపడుతున్న సుహాస్ చాలా సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (1/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (2/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues et tous leurs alliés (Slash et les mutanimaux, Mondo Gecko, Muckman) tentent d'empêcher les Tricératons d'activer le générateur de trou noir et d'aspirer la Terre. En vain. Le capitaine Mozar kidnappe Mikey et l'emmène dans l'espace.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au-delà des frontières de l'espace
programme.desc: Les tortues ont embarqué pour un voyage sidéral sur le vaisseau du Fugitoïde. Elles partent à la recherche du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons après un bond Tachyonique qui leur a permis de changer d'époque.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les lunes de Thalos 3
programme.desc: Les tortues percutent le vaisseau des Salamandres et atterrissent en catastrophe sur une planète recouverte de glace de méthane. Elles doivent de toute urgence récupérer de l'irrilium pour réparer leur vaisseau.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le monde selon Wyrm
programme.desc: En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le chasseur de primes
programme.desc: Lord Dregg envoie Armaggon, un requin chasseur de primes, traquer les tortues. Celles-ci se réfugient dans une station spatiale abandonnée, dirigée par Omni-Intel, un ordinateur de bord qui entend se débarrasser de tous les êtres vivants.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'énigme des Anciens Eons
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde stationne le vaisseau près d'une planète où les Tricératons pensent tenir le premier fragment du générateur de trou noir. Il a bien l'intention de les prendre de vitesse, mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.sub-title: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'arène du carnage
programme.desc: Les tortues arrivent à s'introduire dans le vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Mais elles sont faites prisonnières et deviennent des gladiateurs dans l'arène Tricératon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Bataille pour la Dimension X
programme.desc: Sal et Mona tentent de s'allier avec Krang Second pour combattre les Tricératons. Krang Second les jette en prison. Les tortues sont à la recherche des autres fragments du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'océan cosmique
programme.desc: Les tortues partent à la recherche du deuxième fragment que les Outromes ont confié aux Dagones Celles-ci vivent dans un royaume sous-marin, dans l'océan cosmique de Varuna.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les tortues transdimensionnelles
programme.desc: Alors que les tortues s'apprêtent à partir chercher le dernier morceau du générateur de trou noir, elles sont happées dans un univers parallèle, celui des tortues ninja du dessin animé de 1987.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La vengeance des Tricératons
programme.desc: Les Tricératons ont suivi la trace du vaisseau Ulysse. Ils lancent un ultimatum à son équipage : soit ils leur remettent les fragments, soit ils se font anéantir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Dregg le maléfique
programme.desc: Les tortues captent un signal de détresse. C'est Mona, qui leur apprend que son commandant Sal a été capturé par Armaggon sur l'ordre de Dregg.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le feu éternel
programme.desc: Direction l'autre bout du cosmos, vers une galaxie au nom à rallonge, ZZ-Trois-Pluriel-X-Bêta, et plus particulièrement la planète Magdomar qui abrite selon les Outromes le troisième et dernier fragment du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Ultime chance pour la Terre
programme.desc: Le compte à rebours est lancé avant la mise en route du générateur de trou noir par les Tricératons pour aspirer la planète Terre. Il reste peu de temps aux tortues pour empêcher ces derniers de réduire la planète à néant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La guerre des clans
programme.desc: Retour dans un New York tranquille. Cérémonie pour April, organisée par Splinter. Elle est désormais kunoïchi. Mais le soir même, une mystérieuse sorcière lui vole son tanto du dragon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Foot contre Foot
programme.desc: Leonardo a fait alliance en cachette avec Karaï et Shinigami pour démanteler une à une les opérations de Shredder. Ils commencent par une planque des Dragons Pourpres, puis s'attaquent à l'usine chimique, un lieu névralgique de l'organisation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Infectes insectes
programme.desc: Stockman crée de nouveaux mutants pour l'aider à cambrioler les banques afin de réunir de l'argent pour Shredder. Un ancien homme d'affaires devient Scaramouche, un mutant mi-araignée mi-mouche. Il crée également une fourmi géante.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants contre-attaquent
programme.desc: Don Vizioso veut prendre le contrôle de la ville. Pour cela, il doit se débarrasser des mutants présents dans la ville de New York.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une chauve-souris dans le beffroi
programme.desc: Mikey, Leo et Raph se disputent au sujet de leur BD préférée. Pour Mikey, Bat-Boulon et Écrou Kid sont au-dessus du panier. Leo préfère l'Homme-araignée, Supérieur-Man, ou encore l'Invincible Bossu. Pour Raph, il n'y a pas photo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Super Shredder
programme.desc: Shredder absorbe du mutagène et devient Super Shredder. Il capture Karai pour attirer Splinter dans un piège et en finir avec son ennemi juré. Mais Splinter lit clair dans son jeu et le piège à son tour.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au fond du trou
programme.desc: Tandis que Donnie et Mikey partent explorer le gouffre à la recherche de Splinter, Leo, April et Karai affrontent Super Shredder. Karaï trouve son point faible : son cœur protubérant. Mais le méchant s'échappe à temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Cette force en elle
programme.desc: April a une conduite de plus en plus étrange. Elle est possédée par un ancien Eon, Za-Noran, par l'intermédiaire de son cristal. Les tortues décident de détruire la pierre pour sauver leur amie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tokka contre le reste du monde
programme.sub-title: Tokka contre le reste du monde
programme.desc: Quand Tokka décide de récupérer son petit, c'est le branle-bas de combat sur Terre. Les Forces de Protection Terriennes décident d'attaquer malgré les mises en garde de Bishop.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Tiger Claw et sa sœur Alopex ont été enlevés enfants par les Krangs. Le tigre et la renarde sont devenus ennemis. Alopex vole les lames de la vengeance dans un musée pour détruire son frère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Requiem
programme.desc: Super Shredder teste un nouveau super mutagène concocté par Stockman-mouche, qui se révèle parfait pour sa prochaine mission : exterminer tous ses ennemis sans exception, et sans empathie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La fin
programme.desc: Les tortues rendent visite à Karaï à l'hôpital. Elle leur révèle où se trouve la planque de Super Shredder. Il s'agit d'une forteresse high-tech en pleine forêt, défendue par ses footbots et autres sergents.

programme.desc: Die Turtles freuen sich auf ein lustiges Halloween, als seltsame Monster beginnen, die Einwohner der Stadt zu transformieren.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Die Rückkehr der Foot

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Der große Knall

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Der Leibwächter

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Der verwunschene Wald

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Der Tempelpalast

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Die Wüsten-Krieger

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Das unmögliche Ödland

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Karmageddon

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Michelangelo freundet sich über eine Social-Network-Seite mit seinem Karate-Idol Chris Bradford an. Damit will er beweisen, dass auch die Turtles mit Menschen befreundet sein können. Doch was er nicht weiß: Bradford ist Teil von Shredders Team...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.desc: Die Turtles schleichen sich heimlich aus der Abwasserwelt hinauf in die Stadt, um mit April ins Kino zu gehen. Dort treffen sie auf Baxter Stockman, ein verrückter Erfinder, der sich einen mechanischen Panzeranzug gebaut hat.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donatello hat es satt mit einem einfachen Holzstab gegen die technologisch fortgeschrittenen Kraang zu kämpfen. Deshalb baut er 'Metalhead', einen ferngesteuerten Turtle-Roboter, mit dem er sich gegen die Technologie gewappnet fühlt.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donatello und April untersuchen den Fall eines vermissten Wissenschaftlers. Doch bei ihren Nachforschungen stoßen sie auf ein äußerst mysteriöses Experiment: Es geht um einen übersinnlichen Affen...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Da Leo eine Erpresserbande laufen gelassen hat, befüchtet er nun, dass sich das beim Kampf gegen Xever rächen wird - dieser hat nämlich einen Restaurant-Besitzer gekidnapped.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Nachdem April eine Warnung von ihrem Vater erhalten hat, der immer noch von den Kraang gefangen gehalten wird, begibt sie sich mit den Turtles auf Rettungsmission - Sie müssen Aprils Vater befreien und die Stadt vor einer riesigen Mutagen-Bombe bewahren.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Die Turtles müssen ihr Versteck in der Kanalisation verteidigen, das Bradford durch eine gefährliche Chemikalie zerstören will.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Da es gleich mehrere Bedrohungen gibt, müssen sich die Turtles in zwei Gruppen aufteilen. Donnie und Mikey wollen dabei unter Beweis stellen, dass sie als "B-Team" genauso erfolgreich sind wie Leo und Raphs "A-Team".

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Unidentified Flying Leonardo

programme.desc: Under the Arctic Ocean Krang is tuning up his Robotic Body. While no one is looking, Bebop and Rocksteady inadvertently destroy an important computer chip and surreptitiously replace it with one from a video game.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Super Irma
programme.desc: While the Turtles are busy trying to decide what costumes to wear to this year's Channel Six Halloween party, April and Irma are doing a story on the reverse polarity magnet at Magno-Dyne Labs.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Adventures in Turtle-Sitting
programme.desc: While Splinter is away on meditative satori, Donatello sets his sights on solving world hunger. He invents the food revivafiver, a device designed to reverse the aging process of food.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Sword of Yurikawa
programme.desc: Krang plans to blow up the Tri-State Bridge just as a convoy of trucks carrying a rare form of toxic waste passes overhead.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Return of the Turtleoid
programme.desc: The Turtles go to the Top Notch Scientific Corporation to stand guard over the sonic disintegrator.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Shreeka's Revenge
programme.desc: Shreeka, an alien with an attitude and a vendetta against Krang, after having spent eons tracking him down, has finally found him.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Too Hot to Handle
programme.desc: Donatello tells the other three Turtles that, based on his calculations, the Earth has changed its orbit and is heading for the Sun.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Nightmare in the Lair
programme.desc: Down in the sewers, while Michelangelo, Leonardo, and Raphael are watching yet another cheesy sci-fi film, Donatello is busy building the dream-o-vision.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Phantom of the Sewers
programme.desc: After another night's performance of the robotic Willie Wombat Revue at the Willie Wombat Revue Theatre, a mysterious figure, wearing a long black cape, black fedora, white face mask, and known only as the Phantom, makes an appearance.

programme.title: х/ф Чак и Ларри: Пожарная свадьба
м/ф Angry Birds в кино
programme.desc: На далёком острове посреди океана беззаботно живут птицы. Главным недостатком среди пернатых считается гнев. Красная птица Ред доставляет торт на День вылупления. Из-за небольшого опоздания у него случается конфликт с заказчиком. Ред не выдерживает и устраивает скандал. Обиженные подают в суд на нерадивого собрата. Этот случай является отнюдь не первым проявлением его вспыльчивости. Судья назначает Реду самое строгое наказание на острове: пройти курс по управлению гневом. На занятиях он знакомится с Чаком, помешанным на скорости, Бомбом, прозванным так за свою способность взрываться при сильном волнении, и гигантским Теренсом. Все они являются такими же изгоями и одиночками в птичьем сообществе, как и сам Ред. Через некоторое время на острове происходит нерядовое событие. К берегу причаливает корабль, и из него высаживается зелёная свинья Леонард со своим помощником Россом. По словам гостя, этот визит носит исключительно мирный характер, чтобы установить дружеские отношения между птицами и его народом. Единственным, у кого слова и поведение Леонарда вызывают подозрение, оказывается Ред. Вместе с Чаком и Бомбом он решает проникнуть на корабль свиней, чтобы выяснить их истинные цели… Реж.: Клэй Кэйтис, Фергал Райли, В ролях: Джейсон Судейкис, Джош Гэд, Дэнни МакБрайд, Майя Рудольф, Билл Хэйдер, Питер Динклэйдж, Шон Пенн, Кигэн-Майкл Ки, Кэйт МакКиннон, Тони Хэйл. США-Финляндия, 2016, приключения, комедия

programme.title: м/ф Angry Birds 2 в кино
programme.desc: Отважная птица Ред, а также его друзья Чак и Бомб держат оборону острова пернатых, уверенно отражая атаки зеленых свиней. Между тем на горизонте появляется общая угроза, вынуждающая противников пойти на перемирие: падающие с неба ледяные шары. Свинья Леонард предполагает, что существует еще одна населенная часть суши, остров Орлов, откуда и наносятся удары. Он предлагает Реду и его друзьям объединить силы и вместе устранить проблему. Но чтобы понять, как функционирует устройство, запускающее морозные снаряды, команде необходим инженер. Чак советует попробовать в этой роли его младшую сестру – технического гения Сильвер. При встрече Ред узнает в ней птицу, с которой недавно поссорился во время быстрых свиданий. Несмотря на сидящую глубоко внутри симпатию друг к другу, между ними начинается соперничество за лидерство в команде. Между тем догадки Леонарда оказываются верны. Островом орлов управляет коварная Зета. Она страдает от жизни на леднике и теперь мстит обитающим в тепле свиньям и птицам. Особую злобу она таит на Могучего орла, с которым раньше ее кое-что связывало… Реж.: Туроп Ван Орман, Джон Райс, В ролях: Джейсон Судейкис, Джош Гэд, Лесли Джонс, Билл Хэйдер, Рэйчел Блум, Аквафина, Стерлинг К. Браун, Эухенио Дербес, Тиффани Хэддиш, Дэнни МакБрайд, Питер Динклэйдж. США-Финляндия, 2019, приключения, комедия

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In 2003, Brett Mann and two friends were stranded in the flooded wilds of northern Australia. When Brett swam for help, he was taken by a massive crocodile. But the true horror came next. For nearly 24 hours, the crocodile returned—again and again—carrying Brett’s body, circling the tree where his friends clung to life. It wasn’t just hunting. It was showing them something. Was this predator defending its territory? Sending a message? Or acting with something more than instinct? - In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we examine the terrifying true story of Brett Mann—and ask: - When nature strikes back… is it ever personal?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff dive into the wild waters off Hawaii’s coast, coming face-to-face with sharks and graceful manta rays. The adrenaline peaks when Kyle takes a heart-pounding leap off a towering 40-foot cliff, making this adventure as daring as it is unforgettable.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff explore the breathtaking Waipio Valley, the Hawaiian "Valley of the Kings," in search of prawns and bullfrogs. Their adventure continues up a massive volcano, hunting invasive rams, before ending with a feast of native fish paired with island fruits and spices.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, follow along as Mark Peterson sets out on his second attempt in British Columbia for a Stone Sheep with his Gunwerks muzzleloader. After dealing with terrible weather and not many sheep encounters on his first hunt, Mark is eager to fill his tag this time around. Traveling to some of the best areas for sheep, Mark and the crew have a spectacular week of sheep encounters along with multiple close calls that will tear you down and drive you crazy!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This week is all about Woody, a fearless Jack Russle who spends his free time doing everything from Black Bear hunting in Vancouver to Sheep hunting in the mountains.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Follow along as Mark Peterson travels to Tanzania to hunt the Eastern and Western White-Bearded Wildebeest. These animals are known for their distinctive white beards and large horns, making them a sought-after trophy for hunters on an African safari. Mark sets out on an exciting and thrilling adventure to track down these elusive creatures in the plains of Tanzania.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson heads out on a unique hunt for the rare Anatolian Chamois, a mountain dweller found in the high elevations of northern Turkey. With a storm rolling in, Mark hopes the weather will push the Chamois down from their usual heights, giving him a rare chance to track this prey across the challenging landscape.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: It's 2016 and Mark heads down to Kansas for an early season Muzzleloader Whitetail hunt with Salt River Outfitters. It was hot in the stand with little deer movement until the moon phase switched and - one of the bucks Mark had been looking for stepped out. Kansas is one of those states that has an early Muzzleloader season that opens in September, and if you can get the weather and the moon to align you can catch a big deer on his feet in daylight.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: After coming back from their road trip to Illinois, Jerry is looking to hit the Pennsylvania woods again in search of a buck named Flyer. This is a buck that Jerry passed up last year that he knew held a ton of potential, and after he started getting pictures of him this year, he knew he made the right call. The only problem is that this buck is a traveler and very unpredictable and could be anywhere at anytime. So trying to be in the right spot at the right time proves to be difficult for Jerry.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this adventure we travel to Colorado and hook up with an organization called "Angling with officers" and we jump in the boat with some courageous law enforcement officers from local departments. We also honor the Rapid City, SD SCHEELS Hometown Hero, David Pearcy!

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel to Missouri River near Chamberlain, SD and connect with the South Dakota chapter of Paralyzed Veterans of America for the Joel Niemeyer "Gone Fishing" event. We get to guide and share the story of 100 year old WW2 Veteran Kenneth Carlson and his family. We also honor our next Rochester, MN Scheels Hometown Hero, Dustin Draeger!

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: WWII U.S. Navy veteran Bill Kruschel recounts a journey from humble beginnings in the midst of the Great Depression to his valuable service in the Navy, culminating in a lifelong commitment to the field of special education.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Kelli Campbell Goodnow honors the memory her husband…American hero Shawn Campbell.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Late October is one of the best times of the season to make a move, and Owen Reigler with Midwest Whitetail did just that on a great Iowa buck he calls the 6x6. With an active scrape line, an untouched clover plot, and a good idea of how the buck was using the area, Owen puts together the pieces for a perfect late-October setup.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Youth turkey season in Alabama is always special, but this one means a little bit more. Isaac takes Dylan Hunt to the woods for Alabama’s Youth Opening Weekend with hopes of calling in Dylan a gobbler. Youth season is all about passing on the tradition, and there’s nothing better than watching the next generation experience the thrill of turkey hunting.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Two of the best in the game, get to experience one unforgettable Nebraska hunt. Billy Yargus and Phillip Vanderpool are at Hidden Valley Outfitters in Arnold, Nebraska for a turkey hunt that turned into one they will never forget. Patience, experience, and elite calling paid off when these longbeards finally committed, and came all the way to 20 steps.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: The Alabama turkey opener is a tradition we look forward to every single year. This season, Aaron and Nick from The Hunting Public joined us in camp to kick things off and experience the opener with us. Good friends, strong tradition, and some Alabama gobblers made for an unforgettable start to the season.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: A "Best of..." episode spanning the past 4 seasons of Winchester Life.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: After booking a trip at the last Indian River Clam Restoration banquete, the guys at Gold Key Roofing got a chance to fish with Capt. Blair and Capt. Mike Frenette.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Chris Broome takes Capt. Blair to catch snook at Marco Island.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Hunting isn't about the size of the buck, it's about something much bigger. Jeff Lindsey of The Lindsey Way gets to experience one of the most special moments a father and hunter can ask for, introducing his kids to the outdoors. These are the hunts they'll remember forever.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.
Clay and Crystal Charlton of Take-Em Outfitters are after everything big in Alberta! Giant Lake Trout, Monster Black Bear and Big Muleys!

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Hunting has a way of grounding us, reminding us of what truly matters: shared moments and unforgettable memories. Chance and Ashleigh Eckert are on their first out-of-state hunt in the rolling hills of Ohio. After overcoming a life-changing kidney transplant, their story is one of faith, love, and resilience. While the goal was a big buck, the true reward was the time spent together and the lessons learned along the way. Because hunting is about so much more than the harvest — it’s about the journey.

programme.desc: A team of scientists embarks on a quest to explore the mesopelagic zone or ocean twilight zone which sits beneath the surface layer of the ocean and stretches around the world. This mysterious region just might hold the key to climate change and the planet’s future.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E01 - Sea Level Rise
programme.desc: By 2100 over 1 billion people on Earth will live in low-lying coastal zones. 70% of these will live in Southeast Asia, one of the most vulnerable regions in the world to climate change. The next decade will be the most critical for the future existence of these societies.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E02 - Tsunami Costal Lab
programme.desc: Natural hazards remain a constant challenge for over 400 million people who live in low lying communities built along major mega delta regions in coastal zones. Events like typhoons and tsunamis threaten their very survival.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E03 - Volcanic Field Lab
programme.desc: Many people now know that climate change is real, that they see the data or they see the observations for themselves. What's needed now is a sense of urgency. We have within the next decade exceedingly important decisions to make.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E04 - Food Security
programme.desc: Rice, it's a staple food for many in Asia. It provides 1/3 of the energy in the average Asian diet and is the income source for more than 500 million people. programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: The family are still estranged following Caroline's decision to move back to the decrepit Clearwater house with Du Plessis. Rosie is determined to reunite everyone, and plans a civilised dinner as a step towards reconciliation.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Danny is in prison, accused of murdering Peeters, but Du Plessis is determined to prove his friend's innocence by any means he can. Du Plessis' first attempt backfires disastrously when he harangues a police officer and ends up in a cell next to Danny.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: With Danny away, and Du Plessis undertaking an ignominious stretch of community service, Ed is left in charge of running the Endangered Species Project.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny and Ed are anxiously preparing for a review with JLW, the pharmaceutical company that fund their Endangered Species Project. They are desperate for it to go smoothly, and as a result are driving the rest of the family mad.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Following the loss of their funding, the family are in dire financial straits. Danny and Ed attempt to get an extension on their mortgage but are refused. Fiona spurs Ed on, telling him that the man she used to know would have a plan for survival.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Strange things are happening at Leopard's Den. The family awake to find frogs everywhere, seemingly having rained down overnight; the giraffe refuses to budge from the front gate and the cheetah is off its food.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Scabby Monkey
programme.desc: Contending with overweight cats and their over protective owners was not what Danny Trevanion had in mind when he became a vet. So when a scruffy, barely alive African monkey arrives at his practise Danny is fascinated by the challenge.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Year's Eve at Leopard's Den. Alice has returned, but the stress of combining work with caring for baby Bobby is causing tension between her and Danny. Liv is furious that Fatani hasn't told his mother about their relationship.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Danny is having second thoughts about the wisdom of uprooting his new family and ploughing all their money into a business venture that they know next to nothing about.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Work To Do
programme.desc: A successful giraffe capture means everyone is in high spirits, until the arrival of Evan and Olivia's real father, Simon, throws the family into turmoil.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Meerly Evan
programme.desc: Evan lets the mischievous meerkats loose in Rosie's room to cause havoc. Rosie is devastated when they destroy an irreplaceable photograph of her mother and rages at Evan. She decides once and for all to go back to Bristol.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Evan Meets Elli
programme.desc: Rogue young male elephants are rampaging through Leopard's Den and destroying everything the family have built, so Danny introduces a matriarch elephant in the hope that she will calm them down.
